list.title: ABEMA
list.short_summary: Aiming to revolutionize the industry, "ABEMA" operates as a "new future of television" video streaming business. With no sign-up necessary, the platform offers around 25 channels available 24/7. Its diverse lineup features everything from dedicated 24-hour news to original drama series, romance reality shows, anime, and live sports.
